rubric.criterion: Says the customer can cancel at any time by giving at least 30 days' written notice.
Says that anything already owed up to the day the cancellation takes effect must still be paid.
Says that money paid in advance is normally not refunded.
Gives the exception: if the provider seriously breaks the agreement and does not fix it, the customer gets a proportional refund for the time after cancellation.
Uses short, plain sentences and everyday words, with none of the legal terms of the clause (notwithstanding, provided that, save where, pro rata).
Adds nothing that the clause does not say: no new fees, deadlines, rights or conditions.
